description: A vulnerability in BIG-IP APM occurs when a virtual server with an APM access profile uses a per-request policy containing a form-based Logon Page. Undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate, disrupting traffic. This results in a denial-of-service (DoS) condition on the BIG-IP system. The issue affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. No affected versions or patch information are provided. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.5.
